Rows.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM SpecObj s JOIN galSpecInfo i ON s.specObjID=i.specObjID JOIN PhotoObj p ON s.bestObjID=p.objID JOIN galSpecExtra x ON s.specObjID=x.specObjID JOIN galSpecLine l ON s.specObjID=l.specObjID WHERE s.class='GALAXY' AND s.z>=0.02 AND s.z<0.05 AND x.lgm_tot_p50>=11 AND x.lgm_tot_p50<12.5 AND x.specsfr_tot_p50 BETWEEN -14 AND -7 AND l.h_alpha_flux_err>0 AND l.h_beta_flux_err>0 AND l.oiii_5007_flux_err>0 AND l.nii_6584_flux_err>0 AND l.h_alpha_flux>=3*l.h_alpha_flux_err AND l.h_beta_flux>=3*l.h_beta_flux_err AND l.oiii_5007_flux>=3*l.oiii_5007_flux_err AND l.nii_6584_flux>=3*l.nii_6584_flux_err
